To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
adaptive navigation support for learners in educational hypermedia systems is scaffolded navigation support.
adaptive navigation support can be used as a scaffold to support learners in an educational hyper media system.

(1) adaptive navigation support should be based on a model of the user's learning process; (2) selecting a link is a relevant educational activity and not just a trivial task; (3) learners and users looking for information may need different kinds of adaptive support.
